TOONCAT SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURES AND TABLES
Supplementary tables and figures, in order of reference, for the toonCat manuscript. Includes only the R generated plots, but other figures are noted. See MATLAB scripts and figures folder for other figure components.

```{r Setup, warning=F, message=F, echo=FALSE}
# Setup file
source("~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/code/toonCat_analysisSetup.R")

# Set global variables
output_directory <- "~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/supplementary/tables/"
LMM_filters <- c("hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'", "ROI != 'blank'","ROI != 'blank1'", "category != 'word'", "category != 'words'")
ventralLMM_filters <- c("hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'", "ROI != 'blank'","ROI != 'blank1'", "stream == 'ventral'")
retinotopyLMM_filters <- c("ROI %in% c('V1', 'V2', 'V3')", "hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'")
```


# FUNCTIONS
```{r run_and_format_analysis}
run_and_format_analysis <- function(analysis_list, file_path, file_name, bold_p_value = 0.05, digits = 3) {

  # Helper function to process individual analyses
  run_LMM_analysis <- function(data, formula, filters = NULL, analysis_name) {
  # Apply filters dynamically if provided
  if (!is.null(filters) && length(filters) > 0) {
    filtered_data <- data %>%
      filter(!!!rlang::parse_exprs(filters)) %>%
      na.omit()
  } else {
    filtered_data <- data %>%
      na.omit()
  }

  # Fit the model and perform joint tests
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(formula, data = filtered_data)
  results <- joint_tests(model)

  # Add the analysis name as a column
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(Analysis = analysis_name)

  return(results)
}


  # Process each analysis
  combined_results <- bind_rows(lapply(analysis_list, function(analysis) {
    run_LMM_analysis(
      data = analysis$data,
      formula = analysis$formula,
      filters = analysis$filters,
      analysis_name = analysis$analysis_name
    )
  }))

  # Define the format and save function
  format_and_save_table <- function(results, file_path, bold_p = TRUE, bold_p_value, digits) {
    # Format p-values and F-ratios
    format_p <- function(p) {
      ifelse(p < 0.0001, format(p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 4), format(p, nsmall = 3))
    }
    format_F <- function(Fval) {
      format(Fval, nsmall = digits)
    }

    # Reorder columns to make "Analysis" the first column
    formatted_results <- results %>%
      mutate(
        p.value = as.numeric(p.value),
        p.value = sapply(p.value, format_p),
        F.ratio = sapply(F.ratio, format_F)
      ) %>%
      select(Analysis, everything()) %>%  # Ensure Analysis is the first column
      group_by(Analysis) %>%
      mutate(Analysis = ifelse(row_number() == 1, Analysis, "")) %>%  # Show Analysis name only in the first row
      ungroup()

    # Identify the rows where a new analysis starts (first row of each analysis group)
    add_space_rows <- which(formatted_results$Analysis != "")

    # Generate the table
    table <- formatted_results %>%
      kable(format = "html", booktabs = TRUE, digits = digits) %>%
      kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Calibri")

    # Add spacing above rows where a new analysis starts (excluding the first analysis)
    for (row in add_space_rows[-1]) {  # Skip the first analysis row
      table <- table %>%
        row_spec(row, extra_css = "border-top: 10px solid white;")
    }

    # Apply bolding conditionally based on `bold_p`
    if (bold_p) {
      table <- table %>%
        row_spec(which(as.numeric(formatted_results$p.value) < bold_p_value), bold = TRUE)
    }

    # Save the table
    save_kable(table, file = file_path, zoom = 3, density = 500)

    return(formatted_results)  # Return the formatted results in case further use is needed
  }

  # Construct full file paths
  bold_file_path <- file.path(file_path, "bold", paste0(file_name, "_bold.png"))
  no_bold_file_path <- file.path(file_path, paste0(file_name, ".png"))

  # Save bolded table
  formatted_results_bold <- format_and_save_table(
    results = combined_results,
    file_path = bold_file_path,
    bold_p = TRUE,
    bold_p_value = bold_p_value,
    digits = digits
  )

  # Save non-bolded table
  formatted_results_no_bold <- format_and_save_table(
    results = combined_results,
    file_path = no_bold_file_path,
    bold_p = FALSE,
    bold_p_value = bold_p_value,
    digits = digits
  )

  # Return combined results and paths to saved files
  return(list(
    combined_results = combined_results,
    bold_output_file = bold_file_path,
    no_bold_output_file = no_bold_file_path
  ))
}
```

```{r run_and_format_betas}
run_and_format_betas <- function(analysis_list, file_path, file_name,
                                 bold_p_value = 0.05, digits = 3,
                                 ci_level = 0.95) {

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(kableExtra)
    library(knitr)
    library(lmerTest)
    library(broom.mixed)
    library(emmeans)
    library(rlang)
  })

  # ---------------- Helper function: run one LMM ----------------
  run_LMM_betas <- function(data, formula, filters = NULL, analysis_name) {

    # Apply filters dynamically if provided
    if (!is.null(filters) && length(filters) > 0) {
      filtered_data <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(!!!rlang::parse_exprs(filters)) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na()
    } else {
      filtered_data <- data %>% tidyr::drop_na()
    }

    # Fit the model
    model <- lmerTest::lmer(formula, data = filtered_data)

    # Extract fixed effects
    results <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = ci_level
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        Analysis = analysis_name,
        Term     = term,
        Beta     = estimate,
        SE       = std.error,
        df       = df,
        t        = statistic,
        p.value  = p.value,
        CI_low   = conf.low,
        CI_high  = conf.high
      )

    return(results)
  }

  # ---------------- Run all analyses ----------------
  combined_results <- bind_rows(lapply(analysis_list, function(analysis) {
    run_LMM_betas(
      data = analysis$data,
      formula = analysis$formula,
      filters = analysis$filters,
      analysis_name = analysis$analysis_name
    )
  }))

  # ---------------- Formatting and Saving ----------------
  format_and_save_table <- function(results, file_path, bold_p = TRUE,
                                    bold_p_value, digits) {

    p_numeric <- results$p.value

    # ---- P-value formatter (always show scientific small p's) ----
    format_p <- function(p) {
      vapply(p, function(x) {
        if (is.na(x)) return("")
        if (x < .Machine$double.xmin || x == 0) {
          return("<2.2e-308")
        } else if (x < 1e-4) {
          return(formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3))
        } else {
          return(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3))
        }
      }, character(1))
    }

    format_num <- function(x) format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits)
    format_ci <- function(lo, hi, dig = digits) {
      paste0("[", format(round(lo, dig), nsmall = dig), ", ",
                  format(round(hi, dig), nsmall = dig), "]")
    }

    formatted_results <- results %>%
      mutate(
        Beta    = format_num(Beta),
        SE      = format_num(SE),
        df      = ifelse(is.na(df), "", format(round(df, 1), nsmall = 1)),
        t       = format_num(t),
        p.value = as.character(format_p(p.value)),
        CI      = format_ci(CI_low, CI_high, digits)
      ) %>%
      select(Analysis, Term, Beta, SE, df, t, p.value, CI) %>%
      group_by(Analysis) %>%
      mutate(Analysis = ifelse(row_number() == 1, Analysis, "")) %>%
      ungroup()

    add_space_rows <- which(formatted_results$Analysis != "")

    table <- formatted_results %>%
      kable(format = "html", booktabs = TRUE, digits = digits,
            col.names = c("Analysis", "Term", "β", "SE", "df", "t", "p", "95% CI")) %>%
      kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Calibri") %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)

    if (length(add_space_rows) > 1) {
      for (row in add_space_rows[-1]) {
        table <- table %>% row_spec(row, extra_css = "border-top: 10px solid white;")
      }
    }

    if (bold_p) {
      bold_rows <- which(p_numeric < bold_p_value)
      if (length(bold_rows)) {
        table <- table %>% row_spec(bold_rows, bold = TRUE)
      }
    }

    save_kable(table, file = file_path, zoom = 3, density = 500)
    invisible(formatted_results)
  }

  # ---------------- Save bolded and non-bolded versions ----------------
  bold_file_path    <- file.path(file_path,"bold", paste0(file_name, "_betas_bold.png"))
  no_bold_file_path <- file.path(file_path, paste0(file_name, "_betas.png"))

  formatted_results_bold <- format_and_save_table(
    combined_results, bold_file_path, bold_p = TRUE,
    bold_p_value = bold_p_value, digits = digits
  )

  formatted_results_no_bold <- format_and_save_table(
    combined_results, no_bold_file_path, bold_p = FALSE,
    bold_p_value = bold_p_value, digits = digits
  )

  list(
    combined_results = combined_results,
    bold_output_file = bold_file_path,
    no_bold_output_file = no_bold_file_path
  )
}

```

# Supplementary Table 3. Number of individuals with ROI per group
```{r}
# Create summary table
summary_table <- df.CoV_cat_latdors %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh", "rh")) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(N = n_distinct(subject), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(group, hemi),
    values_from = N) %>%
  mutate(
    # stream label (computed from the raw ROI, before renaming) -> vertical left margin
    Stream = dplyr::case_when(
      ROI %in% c("pOTS_words","mOTS_words","OTS_bodies",
                 "IOG_faces","pFus_faces","mFus_faces","CoS_places") ~ "Ventral",
      ROI %in% c("LOS_limbs","ITG_limbs","MTG_limbs","pSTS_faces")    ~ "Lateral",
      ROI %in% c("MOG_places","IPS_places")                          ~ "Dorsal",
      TRUE ~ ""),
    ROI = stringr::str_replace_all(ROI, "_", "-"),
    ROI = stringr::str_replace_all(ROI, "limbs", "bodies"),
    adolescents_rh = ifelse(ROI == "mOTS-words", " ", adolescents_rh),
    Adults_rh = ifelse(ROI == "mOTS-words", " ", Adults_rh),
    ROI = ifelse(ROI == "pSTS-faces", "pSTS-faces*", ROI),
    ROI = ifelse(ROI == "MTG-bodies", "MTG-bodies*", ROI)) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(Stream) %>%
  # show each stream label only ONCE (on the middle row of its block); blank the rest
  dplyr::group_by(Stream) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Stream = ifelse(dplyr::row_number() == ceiling(dplyr::n() / 2), Stream, "")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Define headers with subcolumns for hemispheres under each measure
# (two leading columns now: Stream + ROI)
measure_headers <- c(
  " " = 2, "Left Hemisphere" = 2, "Right Hemisphere" = 2)

# Manually set column names
colnames(summary_table) <- c(
  " ", "ROI", "adolescents", "Adults", "adolescents", "Adults")

# Create HTML tables
count_table <- summary_table %>%
  kbl(caption = "",  align=('llcccc')) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Calibri") %>%
  # rotate the (single) stream label vertically WITHOUT growing the row:
  # transform rotates after layout, so the cell's layout height stays one line
  # and the word spills visually into the blank cells above/below.
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "1.6em",
              extra_css = "white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-90deg); vertical-align: middle; text-align: center;") %>%
  row_spec(7, extra_css = "padding-bottom: 30px;") %>%
  row_spec(11, extra_css = "padding-bottom: 30px;") %>%
  add_header_above(measure_headers, extra_css = "font-size: 10px;") %>%
 save_kable(file = file.path(output_directory, "S.Table3_ROI_counts.png"),
            zoom = 3,
            density = 500)
```

# Supplementary Table 5: Results of KS-tests
Code run in MATLAB (toonCat_calcKSTests_bootbyROI_csv.m) to get csv
```{r}
library(readr)
library(gt)

# ---- 1) Load ----
df <- read_csv("../data/KS_bootstrap_allResults.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- 2) Row label "ROI - category" (handles faces/bodies/places/words/limbs) ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    roi_noprefix = sub("^(lh|rh)\\.", "", ROI, perl = TRUE),
    base_roi     = sub("_(faces|bodies|places|words|limbs).*", "", roi_noprefix, perl = TRUE),
    cat_tok      = tolower(sub(".*_(faces|bodies|places|words|limbs).*", "\\1", roi_noprefix, perl = TRUE)),
    has_cat      = grepl("_(faces|bodies|places|words|limbs)", roi_noprefix, perl = TRUE),
    label        = ifelse(has_cat, paste0(base_roi, " - ", cat_tok), base_roi)
  )

# ---- 3) Split to LH/RH and carry Bonferroni thresholds; join side-by-side ----
lhs <- df %>%
  filter(hemi == "lh") %>%
  transmute(
    param, label,
    L_thr   = p_thresh_stream,
    LH_Mean = KS_effect_mean,
    # CI with two decimals now; keep raw numbers here for clean formatting
    LH_CI_lo = KS_effect_CI_low,
    LH_CI_hi = KS_effect_CI_high,
    LH_p     = p_value_KS_bootstrap
  )

rhs <- df %>%
  filter(hemi == "rh") %>%
  transmute(
    param, label,
    R_thr   = p_thresh_stream,
    RH_Mean = KS_effect_mean,
    RH_CI_lo = KS_effect_CI_low,
    RH_CI_hi = KS_effect_CI_high,
    RH_p     = p_value_KS_bootstrap
  )

wide <- full_join(lhs, rhs, by = c("param","label"))

# ---- 4) Enforce requested ROI order (rows) ----
roi_order <- c(
  "pOTS - words","mOTS - words","OTS - bodies","IOG - faces",
  "pFus - faces","mFus - faces","CoS - places","LOS - limbs",
  "ITG - limbs","MTG - limbs","pSTS - faces","MOG - places","IPS - places"
)
wide <- wide %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = roi_order))

# ---- 5) Optional: explicit parameter order ----
param_order <- c("X","Y","eccen","size")
wide$param <- factor(wide$param, levels = intersect(param_order, unique(wide$param)))
wide <- wide %>% arrange(param, label)

# ---- 6) Formatting helpers ----
# big, bold markers (no HTML)
star_char <- "\u2731"  # ✱ heavy asterisk
dot_char  <- "\u25CF"  # ● black circle (bold "dot")
thin_sp   <- "\u2009"  # thin space

fmt_ci2    <- function(lo, hi) sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f)", lo, hi)
fmt_p_sci2 <- function(x, mark = "", digits = 2) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x), "—",
    paste0(formatC(x, format = "e", digits = digits),
           ifelse(mark == "", "", paste0(thin_sp, mark)))
  )
}

wide <- wide %>%
  mutate(
    # significance: star if Bonferroni; dot if < .05 but not Bonferroni
    LH_mark = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(LH_p) & LH_p < L_thr ~ star_char,
                               !is.na(LH_p) & LH_p < 0.05  ~ star_char,
                               TRUE                         ~ ""),
    RH_mark = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(RH_p) & RH_p < R_thr ~ star_char,
                               !is.na(RH_p) & RH_p < 0.05  ~ star_char,
                               TRUE                         ~ ""),
    LH_CI_fmt = fmt_ci2(LH_CI_lo, LH_CI_hi),
    RH_CI_fmt = fmt_ci2(RH_CI_lo, RH_CI_hi),
    LH_p_fmt  = fmt_p_sci2(LH_p, LH_mark, digits = 2),
    RH_p_fmt  = fmt_p_sci2(RH_p, RH_mark, digits = 2)
  )

# ---- 7) Keep ONLY display columns ----
wide_tbl <- wide %>%
  select(
    param, label,
    LH_Mean, LH_CI_fmt, LH_p_fmt,
    RH_Mean, RH_CI_fmt, RH_p_fmt
  )

# ---- 8) GT table: Hemisphere → Metric; center everything ----
tab <- wide_tbl %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "param", rowname_col = "label") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Left hemisphere",  columns = c(LH_Mean, LH_CI_fmt, LH_p_fmt)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Right hemisphere", columns = c(RH_Mean, RH_CI_fmt, RH_p_fmt)) %>%
  cols_label(
    LH_Mean = "Mean KS (D)", LH_CI_fmt = "95% CI", LH_p_fmt = "Bootstrap p",
    RH_Mean = "Mean KS (D)", RH_CI_fmt = "95% CI", RH_p_fmt = "Bootstrap p",
    label   = "ROI - category"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(LH_Mean, RH_Mean), decimals = 3) %>%  # means at 3 decimals
  cols_align("center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"), locations = cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Helvetica","Arial"),
    table.font.size  = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black"
  )

tab <- tab %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "✱ Bonferroni-corrected significance (bootstrap *p* < stream threshold)<br>
      Stream thresholds: Ventral = 0.0038; Lateral/Dorsal = 0.0042"
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(source_notes.font.size = px(11))


# ---- 9) Save ----
file_name = "S.Table5_KSTest_boostrap"
gtsave(tab, file.path(output_directory, paste0(file_name, ".png")), vwidth = 1800, vheight = 1800)
gtsave(tab, file.path(output_directory, paste0(file_name, ".pdf")))
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(stringr)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Function to run an LMM, extract betas, format nicely
#---------------------------------------------------------
extract_betas <- function(data, model_formula, analysis_label) {
  
  # 1. Run model
  emm_obj <- data %>%
    lmer(model_formula, .) %>%
    emmeans(~ group | category)
  
  # 2. Adult - adolescent pairwise comparisons
  betas <- pairs(emm_obj, by = "category", reverse = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      Analysis = analysis_label,
      estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      SE = round(SE, 3),
      df = round(df, 1),
      t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 3),
      p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.0001,
                       format(p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
                       format(round(p.value, 3), nsmall = 3)),
      Sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")
    )
  
  return(betas)
}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Run BOTH analyses
#---------------------------------------------------------

# ✅ Analysis 1 dataset: ventral + dorsal-lateral (minus word ROIs)
analysis1_data <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors

analysis1 <- extract_betas(
  data = analysis1_data,
  model_formula = totalvox ~ group * category * stream * hemi + (1|sub),
  analysis_label = "LMM (no words)"
)

# ✅ Analysis 2 dataset: ventral only
analysis2_data <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors %>% filter(stream == "ventral")# <-- you must define this dataset

analysis2 <- extract_betas(
  data = analysis2_data,
  model_formula = totalvox ~ group * category * hemi + (1|sub),
  analysis_label = "Ventral LMM"
)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both sets of betas into ONE clean table
#---------------------------------------------------------

all_betas <- bind_rows(analysis1, analysis2)

# ✅ Order fields in logical layout
all_betas <- all_betas %>%
  select(
    Analysis, category, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value, Sig
  )

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Build a GT table (stacked by Analysis)
#---------------------------------------------------------

betas_table <- all_betas %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Analysis") %>%     # <-- this adds analysis headers
  cols_label(
    category = "Category",
    contrast = "Group Contrast",
    estimate = "β",
    SE = "SE",
    df = "df",
    t.ratio = "t",
    p.value = "p-value",
    Sig = ""
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Sig, rows = Sig == "*")
  ) %>%
  opt_table_font(
    font = list(
      google_font("Times"),
      default_fonts()
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Save to your chosen output directory
#---------------------------------------------------------

gtsave(
  betas_table,
  filename = file.path(output_directory, "S.Table11_All_LMM_ROIsize_emm_betas.png")
)
```

# Supplementary Table 14: Sample-size-matched bootstrap of age-group effects (Figure 3 pRF parameters)
The adult and adolescent groups differ in size. Although the LMMs (S.Tables 6-8) already account for unequal group sizes, we additionally ran a subsample-matching bootstrap as a robustness check: on each iteration the larger (adult) group is randomly subsampled — at the **participant level**, keeping all of each subject's ROI/hemi rows together — to match the adolescent N, the Figure 3 LMM is refit, and **every age-group term — the group main effect and all of its interactions (group:stream, group:category, group:hemi, and higher-order)** — is recorded. Across iterations we report, per term, the median F and p, the 95% bootstrap interval of p, and the proportion of subsamples in which that term is significant (p < .05). A high proportion significant for the interactions that drive the Figure 3 results (e.g. group:category for ROI size and mean t) indicates the effect is not an artifact of the sample-size imbalance.

```{r stable14-bootstrap, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/revision/S.Table14_fig3_bootstrap_all.png",
  "~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/revision/S.Table14_fig3_bootstrap_ventral.png"))
```

## (Computed previously in this Rmd; compute chunks disabled — displaying saved PNGs above)
```{r boot-fig3-fn, eval=FALSE}
library(emmeans)

# Subject-level subsample-matching bootstrap of the age-group main effect.
# Mirrors the S.Table 6-8 LMM (group*stream*category*hemi + (1|sub)).
run_bootstrap_group <- function(data, response, filters,
                                B = 1000, seed = 1,
                                group_var = "group", id_var = "sub",
                                rhs = "group*stream*category*hemi") {
  fdata <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!!!rlang::parse_exprs(filters)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  ids   <- fdata %>% dplyr::distinct(.data[[id_var]], .data[[group_var]])
  adol  <- ids %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[group_var]] == "adolescents") %>% dplyr::pull(.data[[id_var]])
  adult <- ids %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[group_var]] == "Adults")      %>% dplyr::pull(.data[[id_var]])
  n     <- length(adol)
  form  <- as.formula(paste0(response, " ~ ", rhs, " + (1|", id_var, ")"))

  # named vectors of joint-test F ratios / p-values for ALL group terms (main effect + interactions)
  gstats <- function(d) {
    m  <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(lmerTest::lmer(form, data = d)))
    jt <- emmeans::joint_tests(m)
    keep <- grepl("group", jt[["model term"]])
    list(F = setNames(as.numeric(jt$F.ratio[keep]), jt[["model term"]][keep]),
         p = setNames(as.numeric(jt$p.value[keep]), jt[["model term"]][keep]))
  }
  gterms <- names(gstats(fdata)$F)   # group main effect + interactions

  set.seed(seed)
  boot <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    keep <- c(adol, sample(adult, n, replace = FALSE))   # subsample adults to adolescent N
    d    <- fdata %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[id_var]] %in% keep)
    tryCatch(gstats(d), error = function(e) NULL)
  })
  boot <- boot[!vapply(boot, is.null, logical(1))]

  # one row per group term, summarising the bootstrap distribution of F and p
  purrr::map_dfr(gterms, function(tm) {
    Fv <- vapply(boot, function(x) if (tm %in% names(x$F)) x$F[[tm]] else NA_real_, numeric(1))
    pv <- vapply(boot, function(x) if (tm %in% names(x$p)) x$p[[tm]] else NA_real_, numeric(1))
    Fv <- Fv[!is.na(Fv)]; pv <- pv[!is.na(pv)]
    tibble(
      Measure     = response,
      Term        = tm,
      n_per_group = n,
      n_boot      = length(pv),
      median_F    = median(Fv),
      median_p    = median(pv),
      p_CI        = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", quantile(pv, .025), quantile(pv, .975)),
      prop_sig    = mean(pv < 0.05)
    )
  })
}
```

```{r boot-fig3-table, eval=FALSE}
# format + save a bootstrap table in BOTH a bolded (sig rows = median p < 0.05) and a plain version,
# mirroring run_and_format_analysis: bold -> <dir>/bold/<name>_bold.png, plain -> <dir>/<name>.png
boot_kable <- function(boot_df, caption, file_path, file_name) {
  d <- boot_df %>%
    mutate(Measure = recode(Measure,
                            centerY  = "pRF Y-position", centerR = "Eccentricity",
                            size     = "pRF Size",       fwhm    = "VFC FWHM",
                            totalvox = "ROI Size (selectivity)", meanT = "Mean t (selectivity)"),
           sig      = median_p < 0.05,
           median_F = round(median_F, 3),
           median_p = formatC(median_p, format = "f", digits = 3),
           prop_sig = paste0(round(100 * prop_sig, 1), "%")) %>%
    group_by(Measure) %>% mutate(Measure = ifelse(row_number() == 1, Measure, "")) %>% ungroup()
  build <- function(bold) {
    k <- d %>% select(-sig) %>%
      kbl(col.names = c("Measure", "Term", "N/group", "N boot", "Median F",
                        "Median p", "95% CI (p)", "% significant"),
          align = "llcccccc", caption = caption) %>%
      kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Calibri")
    if (bold) k <- k %>% row_spec(which(d$sig), bold = TRUE)
    k
  }
  dir.create(file.path(file_path, "bold"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  save_kable(build(TRUE),  file.path(file_path, "bold", paste0(file_name, "_bold.png")), zoom = 3, density = 500)
  save_kable(build(FALSE), file.path(file_path, paste0(file_name, ".png")),              zoom = 3, density = 500)
  build(TRUE)   # return bolded version for inline display
}

boot_tbl
```

## (Not used in current numbering) Label-permutation test of age-group effects
Empirical null built by shuffling age-group labels across participants and refitting the Figure 3 LMM; retained for reference but not included in the numbered supplementary tables (chunks disabled below).

```{r perm-fn}
# Subject-level label-permutation test of ALL age-group terms (main effect + interactions).
# Shuffles `group` across participants (group sizes preserved), refits the LMM, and
# compares each observed group-term F to its permuted null. One row per group term.
run_permutation_group <- function(data, response, filters,
                                  P = 1000, seed = 1,
                                  group_var = "group", id_var = "sub",
                                  rhs = "group*stream*category*hemi") {
  fdata <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!!!rlang::parse_exprs(filters)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  form <- as.formula(paste0(response, " ~ ", rhs, " + (1|", id_var, ")"))

  # named vector of joint-test F ratios (names = model terms)
  Fvec <- function(d) {
    m  <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(lmerTest::lmer(form, data = d)))
    jt <- emmeans::joint_tests(m)
    setNames(as.numeric(jt$F.ratio), jt[["model term"]])
  }

  obs    <- Fvec(fdata)
  gterms <- names(obs)[grepl("group", names(obs))]   # main effect + interactions

  key <- fdata %>% dplyr::distinct(.data[[id_var]], .data[[group_var]])
  set.seed(seed)
  null_list <- lapply(seq_len(P), function(p) {
    permkey <- key
    permkey[[group_var]] <- sample(permkey[[group_var]])
    d <- fdata %>%
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(group_var)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(permkey, by = id_var)
    tryCatch(Fvec(d), error = function(e) setNames(numeric(0), character(0)))
  })

  purrr::map_dfr(gterms, function(tm) {
    nullF <- vapply(null_list,
                    function(v) if (tm %in% names(v)) v[[tm]] else NA_real_,
                    numeric(1))
    nullF <- nullF[!is.na(nullF)]
    Fobs  <- obs[[tm]]
    tibble(
      Measure  = response,
      Term     = tm,
      F_obs    = Fobs,
      perm_p   = (sum(nullF >= Fobs) + 1) / (length(nullF) + 1),
      null_F95 = unname(quantile(nullF, .95)),
      n_perm   = length(nullF)
    )
  })
}
```

```{r perm-run, eval=FALSE}
perm_fig3 <- bind_rows(
  run_permutation_group(df.centers_cat_latdors, "centerY",  LMM_filters),
  run_permutation_group(df.centers_cat_latdors, "centerR",  LMM_filters),
  run_permutation_group(df.centers_cat_latdors, "size",     LMM_filters),
  run_permutation_group(df.CoV_cat_latdors,     "fwhm",     LMM_filters),
  run_permutation_group(df.ROIsize_cat_latdors, "totalvox", LMM_filters),
  run_permutation_group(df.category_latdors,    "meanT",    LMM_filters)
)
perm_fig3
```

```{r perm-table, eval=FALSE}
perm_tbl <- perm_fig3 %>%
  mutate(
    Measure  = recode(Measure,
                      centerY  = "pRF Y-position",
                      centerR  = "Eccentricity",
                      size     = "pRF Size",
                      fwhm     = "VFC FWHM",
                      totalvox = "ROI Size (selectivity)",
                      meanT    = "Mean t (selectivity)"),
    F_obs    = round(F_obs, 3),
    perm_p   = formatC(perm_p, format = "f", digits = 3),
    null_F95 = round(null_F95, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Measure, Term, F_obs, perm_p, null_F95, n_perm) %>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Measure", "Term", "Observed F",
                    "Permutation p", "Null F (95th pct)", "N perm"),
      align = "llccc",
      caption = "Label-permutation test of age-group terms (group labels shuffled across participants)") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Calibri")

save_kable(perm_tbl, file = file.path(output_directory, "S.Table15_fig3_permutation.png"),
           zoom = 3, density = 500)
perm_tbl
```


# Supplementary Table 16: KS-tests of pRF model fit (R2) between adolescents and adults
Per-ROI, per-hemisphere bootstrapped KS-tests comparing the distribution of pRF variance explained (R2) between adolescents and adults, confirming that pRF model fit does not systematically differ across groups. Reads the KS results computed in the noise-analysis pipeline (`results/revision/toonCat_kstest_r2_results.csv`).
```{r stable16-r2-ks, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/revision/S.Table16_KStest_r2.png")
```

## (Table generated by toonCat_stable16_r2_ci.R — bootstrap 95% CI on the KS D, matching S. Table 5. The disabled chunk below is a superseded per-group draft.)
```{r stable16-r2-ks-old, eval=FALSE}
library(gt); library(tidyr)
star_char <- "✱"; thin_sp <- " "

fmt_ci <- function(m, lo, hi) sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", m, lo, hi)

ks_r2 <- read.csv("~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/revision/toonCat_kstest_r2_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    base_roi   = sub("_(faces|bodies|places|words|limbs).*", "", roi, perl = TRUE),
    cat_tok    = tolower(sub(".*_(faces|bodies|places|words|limbs).*", "\\1", roi, perl = TRUE)),
    label      = paste0(base_roi, " - ", cat_tok),
    Hemisphere = ifelse(hemi == "lh", "Left hemisphere", "Right hemisphere"),
    R2_adol    = fmt_ci(mean_r2_kids,   ci95_lo_kids,   ci95_hi_kids),
    R2_adult   = fmt_ci(mean_r2_adults, ci95_lo_adults, ci95_hi_adults),
    p_fmt      = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", p_boot), ifelse(p_boot < 0.05, paste0(thin_sp, star_char), ""))
  )

roi_order <- c("pOTS - words","mOTS - words","OTS - bodies","IOG - faces",
               "pFus - faces","mFus - faces","CoS - places","LOS - limbs",
               "ITG - limbs","MTG - limbs","pSTS - faces","MOG - places","IPS - places")

tab16 <- ks_r2 %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = roi_order),
         Hemisphere = factor(Hemisphere, levels = c("Left hemisphere","Right hemisphere"))) %>%
  arrange(Hemisphere, label) %>%
  select(Hemisphere, label, R2_adol, R2_adult, ks_stat, p_fmt) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Hemisphere", rowname_col = "label") %>%
  cols_label(
    R2_adol  = "Adolescents R² (95% CI)",
    R2_adult = "Adults R² (95% CI)",
    ks_stat  = "KS D",
    p_fmt    = "Bootstrap p",
    label    = "ROI - category"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = ks_stat, decimals = 3) %>%
  cols_align("center", columns = everything()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"), locations = cells_stub()) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Helvetica","Arial"),
    table.font.size  = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black"
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(source_note = md(
    "R² is the mean variance explained by the pRF model per group (95% CI). ✱ *p* < 0.05 (uncorrected); no region survives correction for multiple comparisons."
  )) %>%
  tab_options(source_notes.font.size = px(11))

gtsave(tab16, file.path(output_directory, "S.Table16_KStest_r2.png"), vwidth = 2000, vheight = 2000)
gtsave(tab16, file.path(output_directory, "S.Table16_KStest_r2.pdf"))
tab16
```
